dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: I've always felt that a library full of books is just like a shelf full of perfumes.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: It's worth taking the time to study and appreciate each one, until you find the one that's perfect for you.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: That experience, of holding onto hope as you search for the one... It's a beautiful thing, worth treasuring.
